summary: For this machine, the simplest local path is the GGUF release served through Ollama. Use Q4_K_M by default; move to Q6_K if you want a little more quality and can tolerate the larger download.

For the vibecluster, VibeThinker is the workload. It is served sudo-free in GPU llama.cpp containers on 7a72 and 7a73; llama.cpp beat containerized ollama on the P4000 at about 42.8 vs 36.3 tok/s. Use the mirrored deploy script to audition flags or restart the service.
